title: Quotient-limit realization and primitive coherent-counit comparisons
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and schemes $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On each small pro-etale site set $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$ for $n\ge1$ and $R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived category $\mathscr D_W=D(\mathscr S(B_{W,\bullet}))$ of whole semilinear systems, with its tensor and geometric inverse image [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. A normalized system has invertible transition adjoints $\alpha^A_{m,n}:q_W^*A_m\to A_n$, where $q_W^*=-\otimes^L_{B_{W,m}}B_{W,n}$, for all $m\ge n\ge1$, with the identity and quotient cocycles [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. For systems $A,N$ on $W$ and $C$ on $Y$, write $T_W(A,N)_n=A_n\otimes^L_{B_{W,n}}N_n$, $F_f(C)_n=Lf_n^*C_n$ for $f:X\to Y$, and $U_W=(B_{W,n}[0])_n$, with the induced whole-system transitions.

Write $\mathcal R_WK=(K\otimes^L_{R_W}B_{W,n})_n$ for coherent reduction [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ for total derived limit of the restricted whole system [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Use the canonical adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ and its natural counit $e_A:\mathcal R_W\mathcal L_WA\to A$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], invertible for normalized $A$ [lem-coef-normalized-dvr-effectivity]. Let $\widehat T_W,\widehat F_f$ be the actual quotient-complex/Roos completed operations [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].

There are resolution-independent natural identifications of functors
$$r_T:\widehat T_W(K,H)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_W T_W(\mathcal R_WK,\mathcal R_WH),\qquad r_F:\widehat F_f(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_XF_f(\mathcal R_YK).$$
They use the actual quotient transitions of the defining flat-term K-flat complexes. More precisely, for a strict restricted tower $X_\bullet$ put $\mathsf C(X)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod X_n\to\prod X_n)[-1]$, where $s((x_n))=(t_nx_{n+1})$. Countable products of module sheaves on the small pro-etale site are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact]. The above identifications use the natural projection-compatible isomorphism $\rho_X:\mathsf C(X)\to R\lim X$ on the derived category of strict towers [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. On a K-injective tower resolution $X\to I$, $\rho$ is $\mathsf C(X)\to\mathsf C(I)$ followed by the inverse of $\lim I\to\mathsf C(I)$ with zero shifted coordinate; the representative identifications are those of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. Thus these are functor comparisons, not separately chosen levelwise isomorphisms.

For normalized $A,N,C$, the maps
$$\beta_T(A,N)=\mathcal L_W(T_W(e_A,e_N))\circ r_T(\mathcal L_WA,\mathcal L_WN),\qquad\beta_F(C)=\mathcal L_X(F_f(e_C))\circ r_F(\mathcal L_YC)$$
are natural isomorphisms. After $r_T,r_F$ their inverses are the images of $T_W(e_A^{-1},e_N^{-1})$ and $F_f(e_C^{-1})$. The counits are the scalar-extension adjoints of the actual total-limit projections and satisfy $e_{A'}\mathcal R_W\mathcal L_W(u)=u e_A$ for every system map $u:A\to A'$, as an equality in $\mathscr D_W$ before evaluation. In particular the projections satisfy $p_n^{A\prime}\mathcal L_W(u)=u_n p_n^A$. This is the naturality governing these primitive comparisons, with the coefficient-extension adjunctions retained in the simultaneous system model.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q21-caa6a999c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: FIX with two small repairs to the item's steps 1–2; both new nodes accepted unchanged. Admissible re-split: the released 2026-10-22 repair note reopens Q38's 6-step split (5833 chars), live and side-live still carry that old proof, neither new id exists, and the item is not superseded. The item statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to side-live, and nothing cites SGA. Step-by-step comparison with the old proof: old step 1 plus the strict-square part of old step 3 became lem-pur-quotient-system-flat-models; old steps 2–3 (ρ normalisation, K-injective formula, projections, descent through roofs, resolution independence) became lem-pur-flat-roos-functor-descent; old steps 4–6 survive as assembly steps 3–5 with the same citations. Nothing was dropped, and the parent proof is 2270 chars (2722 after the fix). Neither new node restates the parent: node 1 has no limit or counit, node 2 has no coefficient tower, no T/F and no β. Node 1 is true. Stacks 0G7E (sites-cohomology lemma-pullback-K-flat) gives the levelwise claim for R→B_n and for u^{-1}; whole-system K-flatness holds because tensor and exactness in S(B) are componentwise; u^{-1} is exact with C=u^{-1}B. Tested on Z→Z/2, constant towers, B_n=0, P=0 and u=id. Node 2 is true. P_i→D(R_i) is a localisation (lem-pc-kflat-resolution, lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent), so Q_Tow∘Z and the cone-of-products construction descend, and ρ comes from lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison under the assumed exact products; Stacks 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok) supplies the K-injective normalisation. Tested on arities 1 and 2, Z=0 and the constant tower. Duplicate candidates checked and rejected: quotient-expression-kflat-normalization (levelwise, DVR towers only), system-evaluation-kflat, kflat-change-of-rings, pe-kflat-roos-representative-invariance, strict-roos-comparison, site-derived-tensor-descent, cochain-tensor-model-rigidity and integral-operations-well-defined (descends only the two fixed functors and has no r_Z). Repairs: (1) step 1 now cites lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus to show that node 1's quotient systems represent the item's R_W, so Z_T and Z_F represent T_W(R-,R-) and F_f(R-) naturally; (2) step 2 now identifies node 2's descended tower functor with Res T_W(R_W-,R_W-) and Res F_f(R_Y-) by node 2's uniqueness clause. Without (2), r_Z lands in R lim of the abstract tower functor rather than in L_W T_W(R K, R H). Steps 3–5 were checked: effectivity needs no boundedness, isomorphism detection is used only for invertibility, both inverse cancellations hold, and the naturality-square order is right. The six declared tool_uses are the black boxes accepted at Q38 and are accepted again. The corrected item is under fixes/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/; proof_deps is unchanged.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
